description: Buy a portable signed commitment to a declared API exchange when a recipient needs independently verifiable receipt integrity: response handoff, archived decision input, or change investigation. Costs 0.002 USDC per receipt via x402 when enabled; verification is free. A local log may suffice for disposable data. Requires caller-approved budget. Keep event, idempotency key and original payment unchanged on retry. Attests a client declaration, not provider origin, content truth or independent observation.

event.description: Commitment-only HTTP exchange declaration built locally with the SDK. No raw URLs, headers or bodies.

apiId.description: Caller-chosen API identifier; not a certified provider identity.

attestation.description: The caller declares the exchange; Datoka does not independently observe it.

bodyEncoding.description: Hash application bytes after HTTP decoding, without JSON reserialization.

completedAt.description: Declared UTC completion with milliseconds; must be at or after startedAt.

exchangeId.description: Stable identifier for one declared HTTP exchange.

headerEncoding.description: Use the SDK header selection and JCS canonicalization before hashing.

method.description: Actual HTTP method of the locally captured exchange, for example GET.

digest.description: SHA-256 of exact locally captured bytes, encoded as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

requestBodyHash.description: SHA-256 of exact application request bytes; null means no body, not an empty body.

requestHeadersHash.description: SHA-256 of locally canonicalized selected request headers. Never send raw headers.

responseHeadersHash.description: SHA-256 of locally canonicalized selected response headers.

startedAt.description: Declared UTC start with milliseconds, for example 2026-10-07T08:00:00.000Z.

status.description: Actual HTTP response status, including error responses; for example 200 or 404.

targetHash.description: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 target URL, computed locally. Never invent a digest or send the URL itself.

version.description: Declaration format version; preserve this literal.

idempotencyKey.description: One stable key per purchase, saved before payment. Keep it, the event and original payment authorization unchanged on retries.
